title: aster helenium
intro: Aster helenium, commonly known as Sneezeweed, is a flowering plant native to North America, belonging to the family Asteraceae. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, aiding in digestion, and acting as a natural antiseptic. Its therapeutic actions include its ability to stimulate the nervous system, relieve respiratory issues, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Aster helenium include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and polyphenols, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
